"'''Deathrain'''" was a [[TIE pilot/Legends|TIE pilot]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Deathrain often piloted a [[TIE/ca Punisher/Legends|TIE/IT Interdictor starfighter]], also known as the TIE Punisher. As the handle implied, Deathrain's specific role was that as a bomber pilot. At one point, they released a salvo of [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] on the enemy as part of an attack alongside several other TIE Punishers.
